custom_plotting_rationale: The real native case is 1D; custom curves and a line-state animation preserve this honestly. The portable helper is optional and its animations support map/points only.
instruction_strengths: Actual target/start/native state and AD cotangent required explicitly
True parameter coordinates and temporal sampling conventions required
No invented wavefields or regional-to-spatial derivatives
Shared comparison scales, unclipped statistics and reproducible manifests
README gallery and inspection of rendered exports
limitations: One-dimensional scalar fixture only; no 2D/3D or continuum-accuracy claim.
Only starting-model native displacement history was saved; no target-model wavefield is invented.
Processed objective formula/processing operator is absent from allowed artifacts; saved AD cotangent and its recorded verification are shown without reconstructing that objective.
Original timing samples/uncertainty are unavailable; no controlled speedup chart is made.
Numerical checks are historical saved evidence, not re-executed by this plotting-only application.
retained_warnings: Fontconfig cache warning, output successful; subsequent run uses writable XDG cache
Initial canvas audit false positive for undrawn off-axis ticks, repaired with original audit retained
